sentences.en: HWM usage is the high water mark (HWM) or peak memory usage that has been consumed since the activation of the database partition when the db2start command was run.

sentences.en: The properties of flame retardance, thermal stability, mechanics and the morphology of the home made flame retardant high wet modulus (HWM) viscose fibers modified by grafting were examined.

sentences.en: HWM Used (KB): High-water mark, or peak, memory that the consumer has used.

sentences.en: Zhao Wei: I think Hazardous Waste Management (HWM) is a new concept for most of the Chinese people. So how do you think it relates to our life?
sentences.vi: Zhao Wei: Tôi nghĩ Quản lý Chất thải Nguy hại (HWM) là một khái niệm mới đối với hầu hết người dân Trung Quốc. Vậy bạn nghĩ nó liên quan đến cuộc sống của chúng ta như thế nào?

sentences.en: Background samples are typically needed from the water source used for thedecontamination procedures and from unimpacted soils near the HWM facility.
